lines.zh: 我在河岸上小跑，肚子贴地。
lines.en: I trot the riverbank with my belly low.
Once ashore I walk a little clumsily.

lines.zh: 四只脚踩着湿石头下去。
lines.en: Four paws pick down the wet rocks.

lines.zh: 我一头扎进河里，水花很小。
lines.en: I slip into the river with hardly a splash.

lines.zh: 水里的我比岸上快得多。
lines.en: In the water I am far faster than ashore.
I shoot forward along the riverbed.
A stroke of my webbed paws sends me off.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙滩走，留下小脚印。
lines.en: I leave small prints along the beach.
A wave hits and I brace myself.

lines.zh: 我爬上礁石，毛还滴着水。
lines.en: I climb the rock, fur still dripping.
I squeeze through the gap in the stones.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩身子，水甩了一地。
lines.en: I shake myself and water flies everywhere.
I drift with the current for a while.
Before landing I poke my head up to look.

lines.zh: 我踩着一排圆石跳过浅沟。
lines.en: I hop the shallow ditch along a line of stones.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴拨水，慢慢往前挪。
lines.en: I paddle with my tail and inch forward.

lines.zh: 我沿着湿泥走，爪印很深。
lines.en: I walk the wet mud, leaving deep prints.

lines.zh: 我爬到那段倒木上，抖了抖。
lines.en: I climb onto the fallen log and shake off.

lines.zh: 我仰面浮着，爪子放胸前。
lines.en: I float on my back, paws on my chest.
I comb my fur with my paws.

lines.zh: 河面上有虫子，我看了看。
lines.en: Bugs skim the river; I watch them.
I lie on a stone and dry my back.

lines.zh: 水从我的胡须上滴下来。
lines.en: Water drips from my whiskers.

lines.zh: 我蜷起来，尾巴盖住鼻子。
lines.en: I curl up with my tail over my nose.

lines.zh: 有鱼跳出水面，我懒得动。
lines.en: A fish jumps; I cannot be bothered.
I flip pebbles in the shallows for fun.
The riverside grass rustles in the wind.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，露出一嘴小牙。
lines.en: I yawn and show a mouthful of small teeth.
I lick my wet fur into little tufts.
I listen to the water, eyes half shut.

lines.zh: 石头底下冒出几个气泡。
lines.en: A few bubbles rise from under the stone.
I lie still, tail tapping the water.
You crouch down; I look up at you.
Your hands smell of fish.
I tilt my head and my whiskers twitch.
You come too close; I shrink back.
Your boots are covered in river mud.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼睛，不怕你。
lines.en: I hold your gaze; I am not afraid.
Are you getting in? I will watch first.

lines.zh: 我围着你转了一圈，闻了闻。
lines.en: I circle you once and sniff.

lines.zh: 你这么大，不像来抓鱼的。
lines.en: So big, and you do not look like a fisher.
I plop back into the river.
It hurts; a tuft of fur is torn out.
Ten health will not take many hits.
Wet fur against stone, I shiver.
The wound soaks in water and stings.
I whimper and back away.
Do not hit my belly.

lines.zh: 河岸的石头硌到了我的腿。
lines.en: The riverbank stones caught my leg.

lines.zh: 血滴在石头上，很快冲掉。
lines.en: Blood drips on stone and is quickly washed away.
I can still swim, half a beat slower.
Hit me again and I will bite back.

lines.zh: 鱼的味道从你口袋出来。
lines.en: Fish smell comes from your pocket.
Give me a fish and I will stay.

lines.zh: 我盯着那条鱼，眼睛都不眨。
lines.en: I stare at that fish without blinking.
If there is fish, I can come closer.
The fish in your hand is still dripping.
I smell river shrimp; I eat those too.
My belly growls; I forget my pride.
Put the fish down; I will take it myself.
I reach my paw toward your hand.
After this one I will want more.

lines.zh: 你踢到我了，我溜进水里。
lines.en: You kicked me; I slip into the water.
My wet fur rubs against your leg.
I just surfaced for air—do not step.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我翻了身。
lines.en: We bump and I roll over.

lines.zh: 我蹭着你的腿游过去了。
lines.en: I slide past your legs.
You are blocking my way ashore.
That knocks me into the shallows.
I shook water on you; sorry.
Move; I want that stone.
I walk against you; that hardly counts.

lines.zh: 河湾那边有只水獭在叫。
lines.en: An otter calls from the river bend.
We swim abreast, whiskers touching.
I bring it a fish.
It waits for me on the stone.

lines.zh: 我们互相理毛，理了很久。
lines.en: We groom each other for a long while.
The den is lined with dry grass and feathers.
It enters the water first; I follow.

lines.zh: 这条河湾够养两只小的。
lines.en: This bend could raise two pups.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子顶了顶它的脸。
lines.en: I nudge its face with my nose.
It is cold; we press together.
I pick up a round stone.
I am taking this shell.
I hold the fish in my mouth and will not drop it.
I pick up anything shiny.
I carry a bundle of grass to the den.
This bone will do for gnawing.
My paws cannot hold it; it drops.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西都藏在石缝。
lines.en: I hide my finds in the rock crevice.
I drag the small fish ashore to eat.
This is for my future den.
A fish is behind the stone.
I mark the slow one.
A crab walks sideways in the shallows.

lines.zh: 水花一响，我就知道有货。
lines.en: A splash tells me there is prey.

lines.zh: 它躲进石缝，我守在外头。
lines.en: It hides in a crevice; I wait outside.
I have fixed on that frog.
This target is small, one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我从下游往上游摸过去。
lines.en: I work my way up from downstream.
It is hurt and swimming crooked.
First I check its escape route.
I sink until only my eyes show.
The current hides my movement.

lines.zh: 它每摆一次尾，我就近一点。
lines.en: Each beat of its tail brings me closer.
I hug the riverbed without bubbles.
It has slipped behind the stone.
I wait for it to leave the crevice.
My whiskers search the water for it.
The moment it shows, I move.
I swing downstream to cut that off.
It has not noticed me and keeps feeding.
I bite into the fish's back.
My paws pin it down.
I shake my head and drag it ashore.
This bite catches only scales.
It thrashes and the water muddies.
I hold on until it goes limp.
The crab pinches my nose.
I crack the shell on a stone.
After eating I lick my paws.
This strike is only to fill my belly.

lines.zh: 我在河边的浅滩上睁眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes on a river shoal.
Wet sand and broken shells lie at my feet.

lines.zh: 岩石海岸的风带着咸味。
lines.en: The wind off the rocky shore tastes of salt.
I jump into the water to test it.
The river is shallow and full of fish.
There are other prints on the beach.
I surface and shake water all over you.
I search the bank for a den.
The tide has just gone out, baring the rocks.
I get in the water first and think later.
Fire singes my fur; the smell is sharp.

lines.zh: 我从石头上滑下去，摔得闷。
lines.en: I slide off the stone and land hard.
Dove too long; water in my nose.
The blast throws me into the river.
An arrow grazes my shoulder, fur flying.
Magic makes all my fur stand up.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我连鱼都追不上。
lines.en: Starved long, I cannot even catch fish.
Thunder cracks over the river; I dive into the den.

lines.zh: 下面没有河，也没有石头。
lines.en: Below there is no river and no stone.
